items.text: Gulls now avoid obstacles more reliably, stay on surface, have reduced startle radius, inherit velocity when killed, and can spawn in deep‑sea zones.
Birds can glide; flocks no longer flap while descending, flee distance increased to 1000 m for better explosion tracking, and crows circle corpses from higher altitude.
Added missing seagull spawn points in floating city, ferry terminal, and lighthouse, ensuring seagulls appear in those areas.
UZI damage and durability have been doubled.
Fixed a null‑reference crash when phones are destroyed, improving overall stability.
Monument markers are now generated during world setup, cutting initial map open time from ~19 ms to ~2.7 ms.
Corrected right‑to‑left language formatting when passing arguments, fixing display issues for non‑RTL languages.
Fixed animal name display for right‑to‑left languages, ensuring proper localization.

2026-11-02.summary:
### AI & Wildlife
- Gulls now avoid obstacles more reliably, stay on surface, have reduced startle radius, inherit velocity when killed, and can spawn in deep‑sea zones.
- Birds can glide; flocks no longer flap while descending, flee distance increased to 1000 m for better explosion tracking, and crows circle corpses from higher altitude.
- Added missing seagull spawn points in floating city, ferry terminal, and lighthouse, ensuring seagulls appear in those areas.

### Weapon Balance
- UZI damage and durability have been doubled.

### Phone System Stability
- Fixed a null‑reference crash when phones are destroyed, improving overall stability.

### Map Performance
- Monument markers are now generated during world setup, cutting initial map open time from ~19 ms to ~2.7 ms.

### UI & Localization
- Corrected right‑to‑left language formatting when passing arguments, fixing display issues for non‑RTL languages.
- Fixed animal name display for right‑to‑left languages, ensuring proper localization.

### World Generation
- Ice Lake placement rebalanced: larger ice lakes now spawn more often and anchors are used more sparsely, resulting in more varied lake distribution across new maps.

### Animals & AI
